question: What will the first reported revenues after September 2026 be for the following companies? (SpaceX)

calls.reasoning: Q2 2026 revenue was $7.81B, and Q3 adds the first full quarter of Anthropic's $1.25B/month Colossus payments (~$3.75B), plus Cursor from its Aug 14 close (~$0.5-0.7B) and continued Starlink growth. Building up from the segments gives ~$11.2-13.8B; Street consensus is $12.9-13.1B and UBS is at $13.8B. Q2 beat consensus by 13%, so there is upside skew, but the Colossus 2 ramp timing is uncertain. Median ~$13.1B. No Polymarket, Kalshi, Manifold or bookmaker market was found. Escape outside $10-16B needs a contract shortfall or a reporting redefinition, so ~1% on each side.
calls.dossier:
- SpaceX (SPCX) IPO closed Jun 15 2026; first public earnings were Q2 2026, reported Aug 4 2026 (SEC 8-K earnings release).
- Q1 2026 total revenue $4.694B (Space $0.619B, Connectivity $3.257B, AI $0.818B) (8-K).
- Q2 2026 total revenue $7.814B, +92% YoY (Space $0.962B, Connectivity $4.291B, AI $2.561B); consensus had been ~$6.9B, so the Q2 beat was ~13% (8-K; Fortune Aug 4 2026).
- The 8-K gave no forward revenue guidance.
- Anthropic pays SpaceX $1.25B/month through May 2029 for Colossus 1 compute, with reduced payments in May-Jun 2026 during the ramp (Axios May 20 2026); the deal was later expanded to Colossus 2 (Anthropic news / eeNews).
- The Cursor acquisition ($60B) closed Aug 14 2026; Cursor had ~$4B annualized revenue before the deal (TheNextWeb; Wikipedia).
- Musk said AI revenue would exceed rockets by September; the CFO cited a path to $100B ARR including Cursor (search snippets of Q2 call coverage).
- Q3 consensus revenue is $12.9B (Yahoo/Stocktwits, Sep 29 2026); another snippet says $13.11B. UBS forecasts $13.8B: AI $7.6B, Connectivity $4.9B (+59%), Space $1.3B.
- Q3 report date is unconfirmed: Stocktwits says Tue Nov 3 2026 after the close; other calendars say Nov 5 or Nov 17 (X post / Investing.com).
- Resolves off SpaceX's first reported revenue for a period after September 2026, presumably Q3 2026 (quarter ending Sep 30) total revenue, not ARR or segment figures.
- Event window: the Q3 2026 quarter (Jul 1 -> Sep 30 2026) has fully elapsed; only the report itself is pending as of Oct 7 2026.
- Bottom-up arithmetic: Anthropic 3 x $1.25B = $3.75B; Cursor ~1.5 months ≈ $0.5-0.7B; legacy xAI/X ~ $0.8-1B; Colossus 2 increment unknown.
- Searched for but not found: company Q3 guidance; Colossus 2 payment terms; any prediction market on SpaceX Q3 revenue.

calls.dossier:
- Resolution: the first revenue figure SpaceX (SPCX) reports after September 2026, which should be Q3 2026 (Jul-Sep) quarterly revenue from its earnings release. Date unconfirmed: Stocktwits lists Nov 3, 2026 after close; Investing.com lists Nov 5; StockAnalysis/NextEarningsDate listed Nov 17 (X post by @TeslaLarry, ~Oct 2026). Scheduled question resolution is Nov 3, 2026 21:00Z.
- Q2 2026 (reported Aug 4, 2026, first report since IPO): revenue $7.8B, +92% YoY; consensus had been $6.81B (+15% surprise). Segments: Connectivity/Starlink $4.3B (+66% YoY), Space $962M (+29%), AI $2.56B (+247%). Adj EBITDA $3.5B; net loss $541M; capex $18.4B (CNBC, Qz, Aug 2026).
- Q1 2026 AI Solutions & Infrastructure revenue was $475M; in Q2 it was $2.2B, of which $1.6B was cloud services (Motley Fool/Yahoo, ~Oct 1, 2026).
- Anthropic agreement: a full $1.25B monthly payment could add about $3.75B of quarterly revenue in Q3 (Fool/Yahoo, Oct 2026).
- Starlink ARPU was $66/month in Q2 (flat QoQ, down from $85 a year earlier); management expects $66 or more. Falcon launches: 37 in Q2 vs 40 in Q1.
- Q3 Street consensus revenue: about $12.84-13.11B depending on aggregator (Yahoo/Stocktwits UBS piece, MarketBeat, Investing.com, Sept-Oct 2026).
- UBS Q3 forecast: revenue $13.8B (about 7% above Street), adj EBITDA $7.5B; AI $7.6B, Connectivity $4.9B (+59% YoY), Space $1.3B.
- FY2026 analyst revenue estimate about $44.8B. Musk targets a $100B annualized revenue run rate by end of 2026.
- Status quo: the reported number usually lands within ±10% of consensus for large companies; this company has one public data point (+15% beat).
- Downside mechanisms: AI cloud contract revenue ramping slower or recognized differently; lower Starlink ARPU; fewer launches. Upside: more AI contracts and a full quarter of Anthropic payments.
- Markets: no Polymarket/Kalshi/Manifold market on Q3 revenue found; Polymarket had a Q2 'beat earnings' contract.
- Searched but not found: any official company Q3 revenue guidance, or an exact confirmed release date.
- Event window: Q3 2026 report release (expected early November 2026). As of Oct 7, 2026 the quarter has ended but nothing has been reported.
